name: podium-eden-hall
brief: Five neighbours in Eden are holding a little talks evening. Everyone meets in the classroom east of the commons and sits at the desks; then each, in the agreed order, walks up to the front of the room by the teacher's desk and the big screen and gives one short talk to the others, while the rest listen.

room.label: the classroom east of the commons

podium.label: the front of the classroom, by the teacher's desk and the big screen

seats.character: Mara keeps bees behind the market gardens; warm, organised and the one who called the evening. She opens it and welcomes everyone.
seats.topic: what the bees taught her about sharing a commons, and a welcome to everyone

seats.character: Tobias runs the bakery; early riser, dry humour, never uses two words where one will do.
seats.topic: why bread tastes better when the whole village smells it baking

seats.character: Juniper looks after the observatory; dreamy and precise, she counts things and loves the night sky.
seats.topic: the three stars you can always find from the commons

seats.character: Ezra plays fiddle at the bandstand; restless, funny, a little nervous in front of a room.
seats.topic: the tune he cannot stop humming and where it came from

seats.character: Lin is new to Eden, arrived last week by the harbour; curious, polite and a careful listener who closes the evening.
seats.topic: her first week in Eden and the place she likes best so far

notes: Playtest round 2 (team/PLAYTEST-ROUND2-20261026.md #6). Eden 2026 has no indoor podium: the presentation room is the classroom eden-classroom-1 (core/hall at 42,-8.5, one room 'Classroom' 16 x 19 m, nine desks and chairs facing north) and the podium is the front of the room between op classroom-teacher (office desk, 37.8,-15.0) and op classroom-court-screen (42,-17.1): pos [40,-16], radius 3 m, which leaves the nearest audience chair (classroom-chair-1-x, z -11.8) more than 4 m away. The outdoor op commons-podium (9,-2, on commons-deck by commons-pavilion) is the alternative if the classroom will not do. Presence: placePath names containing eden-classroom-1. fromPodium: each talk's lines were spoken with the speaker's last ended receipt within 3 m of pos.
